summary: Rerun pilot-only nested CV at 10 folds to cut data loss per fold and fold variance
reasoning: Observation step-17 contradicted the widened grid: cv_auc 0.7843. Interior k (51, 71, distance) is now chosen, so the grid is adequate; the shortfall looks like data hunger (5-fold trains on 800/1000) and fold variance (fold AUCs 0.74-0.83). Fix within route: raise the CV protocol to 10-fold nested (outer 10 x inner 10, same grid, same seed) via the existing --folds flag — no change to model family, features or tuning set. 10-fold measures 900-row models, closer to the 1000-row deployed model, and averages more folds. Expect cv_auc to rise ~0.01-0.03 to >= 0.80. Model still on the twelve standardised features, tuning only k and weights; heldout untouched; metrics keeps only cv_auc. Cost ~2400 tiny single-threaded fits, minutes.
